# TechTarget

> > TechTarget is a global network of information technology websites providing enterprise technology news, expert analysis, and B2B marketing solutions across AI, cloud computing, data management, and cybersecurity.

TechTarget operates as both a leading IT media platform and a B2B marketing services provider, connecting technology vendors with enterprise decision-makers through specialized content sites and partner integrations. The network features expert contributors covering emerging technologies including AI agents, cloud storage solutions from vendors like Pure Storage and Microsoft, and data management platforms from companies like Teradata and Alation.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise Technology News
- B2B Marketing & Sales Services
- AI Agents & Artificial Intelligence
- Cloud Computing & Cloud Storage
- Data Management & Curation Automation
- Cybersecurity & IT/OT Convergence
- Microsoft 365 & Microsoft Solutions
- Pure Storage & Storage Solutions
- Teradata & Data Analytics
- Tech Partner Integrations
- Campaign Management
- IaaS & PaaS Platforms
- Natural Language Processing
- ComputerWeekly.com.br (Brazil)

## Core Platform & Services

- [TechTarget - Global Network of Information Technology Websites and Contributors](https://www.techtarget.com): Homepage for TechTarget's global IT news network covering AI, cloud, data
- [Find the right TechTarget Tech Partner](http://partners.techtarget.com/integrations): TechTarget Tech Partner directory for B2B marketing and sales services
